description: Find Facebook Pages and public profiles by keyword, or read a list of Facebook URLs, IDs or handles. No login, cookies or proxy setup required.

addDetail.description: Add creation date, whether the Page is currently running ads, and its public Page Transparency ID. Adds one request per result.
addDetail.title: Include Page Transparency

categoryFilter.description: Optional case-insensitive text filter on a page's category, e.g. 'dentist' or 'restaurant'. Applied after page details are read; leave empty for all categories.
categoryFilter.title: Category Contains

fetchPageDetails.description: Open each result to add category, contact details, follower counts, ratings and reviews links. Turn off for a fast identity-only list of names, URLs, IDs and verification badges.
fetchPageDetails.title: Fetch Page Details

includePosts.description: Add up to maxPosts recent posts from the Page/profile timeline (text, timestamp, permalink, media and engagement when visible).
includePosts.title: Include Recent Post

includeReviews.description: Fetch up to 10 real reviews per page when Facebook publishes them. Adds one request per result.
includeReviews.title: Include Reviews

location.description: A city or country added to every keyword, e.g. 'Berlin' or 'Kansas City, Missouri'. Facebook search is relevance-ranked, so this narrows results toward that place; it is not a strict geographic filter.
location.title: Location Hint (optional)

locationUids.description: Optional numeric Facebook Place IDs, one page search per UID, e.g. 108591349161413 from facebook.com/places/<id>/. maxResults is distributed across the UIDs and duplicate pages are removed. Results can include nearby businesses; this is not a strict city boundary.
locationUids.title: Location UIDs (partitioned pages search)

maxPosts.description: Maximum recent posts to keep per result when includePosts is on. Facebook may serve fewer when the timeline is empty or restricted.
maxPosts.title: Maximum Posts Per Page

maxResults.description: Upper bound on rows per search query (mode=search) or in total (mode=urls). Facebook may return fewer when the index is exhausted. Deep searches use extra networking automatically.
maxResults.title: Maximum Results

mode.description: Choose whether to discover Pages/profiles by keyword or read the Facebook URLs you already have.
mode.title: Mode

rehostImages.description: Copy profile and cover images into Apify storage so their URLs stay valid, instead of returning Facebook's signed CDN links (which expire after about five days). Adds one download per image.
rehostImages.title: Rehost Images

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search on Facebook (mode=search), e.g. 'coffee shop', 'dentist Berlin'. A pasted facebook.com/search/pages/?q=... URL is accepted too. Either this or startUrls is required.
searchQueries.title: Search Keywords

searchType.description: Search for Pages, public profiles, or both. Applies to mode=search.
searchType.title: Result Type

startIds.description: Numeric Facebook IDs or @handles to read (mode=urls), e.g. 100064458773195 or @McDonalds. Combine with startUrls if you have both. Either startUrls, startIds or searchQueries is required.
startIds.title: Facebook IDs or Handles

startUrls.description: Direct Facebook Page or profile URLs to read (mode=urls), e.g. https://www.facebook.com/McDonalds, https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=..., /people/... or /p/.... Either startUrls, startIds or searchQueries is required.
startUrls.title: Facebook URLs

verifiedOnly.description: Keep only results Facebook marks as verified. Unverified or unknown results are dropped.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified Pages Only

title: Facebook Page & Profile Finder Input
